name: UK inflation & rates
summary: UK CPI 3.5% and a Bank of England rate rise expected on 5 Nov
state: UK CPI inflation rose to 3.5% in September from 3.1%. Bank Rate is 3.75%, and money markets almost fully price a rise at the 5 Nov meeting, with further increases priced for February and July (Trading Economics, 30 Oct).
for_you: Mortgage rates are more likely to rise than fall in the coming months. Savings rates may also edge up.
rubric_hit: CPI 2.5–4.0%, or the BoE reversing course.

sources.title: Trading Economics — UK 10-year gilt yield and BoE expectations

why: UK inflation and the Bank Rate set mortgage, savings and business borrowing costs for the whole country.
drivers: Energy prices, wages, services inflation, sterling, global rates.

rubric.alert: CPI > 4.0%, or an emergency BoE move.
rubric.watch: CPI 2.5–4.0%, or the BoE reversing course.
rubric.normal: CPI ≤ 2.5% and Bank of England moving gradually or on hold.
